def transform(grid):
    """Task-72c1583a: Winner has larger (below - above) diff; on tie, fewer above wins.
    The 5-line divides the grid into upper and lower sections. We measure each color's
    extension: count of its cells above and below the 5-line in its respective column.
    The winner is the color with the larger difference (below - above). When tied,
    the color with fewer cells above wins. Default is 2s."""
    
    # Find 5-line row
    line_row = None
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(c == 5 for c in row):

    col_2 = next(c for c in range(9) if any(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(len(grid))))

    above_2 = sum(1 for r in range(0, line_row) if grid[r][col_2] == 2)

    below_4 = sum(1 for r in range(line_row + 1, len(grid)) if grid[r][col_4] == 4)
    
    # Determine winner by diff
    diff_2 = below_2 - above_2
    diff_4 = below_4 - above_4
    
    if diff_2 > diff_4:
